findings.issue: Wrong grammar fact: に is called 'the adverbial form of the verb 見える'. に is not a form of 見える at all; per the token note it is the adverbial に of the copula だ (or the particle marking what he appears to be), linking 三十過ぎ to 見える.
findings.current: The に here is not the time particle, but the adverbial form of the verb 見える (to seem/appear).
findings.suggested: The に here is not the time particle, but the adverbial に form of the copula だ, linking 三十過ぎ to 見える (to seem/appear).

findings.issue: Same wrong grammar fact as expl_en: calls に 'a forma adverbial do verbo 見える'. に is not a form of 見える; it is the に adverbial do auxiliar だ (consistent with the token note), ligando 三十過ぎ a 見える.
findings.current: O に aqui não é a partícula de tempo, mas a forma adverbial do verbo 見える (parecer/aparentar).
findings.suggested: O に aqui não é a partícula de tempo, mas a forma adverbial に do auxiliar だ, ligando 三十過ぎ ao verbo 見える (parecer/aparentar).

findings.issue: Wrong reading: ７日 as day-of-month is read なのか, not ななか. The token role note itself states '七日 = なのか'. The kana contradicts it.
findings.current: ななかからがっこうがはじまる
findings.suggested: なのかからがっこうがはじまる

findings.issue: Token reading for ７ given as なな, but in ７日 (the 7th of the month) the reading is なのか, so the ７ segment should read なの (with 日 = か).
Same wrong reading propagated to romaji: 'nanaka' should be 'nanoka' (７日 = nanoka). Not the known punctuation/katakana issue — this is a reading error.
The し segment of どうして is glossed 'to print' in English — a gloss for the unrelated verb 刷る(する). The pt gloss correctly says it is part of どうして 'why'. The en gloss teaches a false meaning.

Inaccurate literal mirror: 元気そうに means 'looking/seeming energetic' (appearance そう), but lit_en renders it 'energetically', dropping the appearance meaning. lit_pt correctly has 'parecendo cheio de energia'.
findings.current: As for him, he's walking energetically.
findings.suggested: As for him, looking energetic, he is walking.

findings.issue: Nuance mistranslation: 丁寧に means politely/carefully/courteously, not 'patiently' (that would be 辛抱強く). lit_en and the token gloss both correctly say 'politely'.
findings.current: He patiently showed me the way.
findings.suggested: He politely showed me the way.

findings.issue: Same nuance mistranslation as en: 丁寧に is 'com cuidado/educadamente', not 'com toda a paciência' (paciência = 辛抱強く). Contradicts the token gloss 'educado/atencioso'.
findings.current: Ele me ensinou o caminho com toda a paciência.
findings.suggested: Ele me ensinou o caminho com toda a atenção.

findings.issue: Typo in Portuguese: 'açao' is missing the tilde; should be 'ação'.
Ungrammatical English: an exclamative ('What a beautiful house') cannot take a tag question ('isn't it?'); tags attach to declaratives. Rephrase as a declarative + tag to mirror ですね.
findings.current: What a beautiful house, isn't it?
findings.suggested: It's a beautiful house, isn't it?
